close: Close this window without starting another operation.
closeButton: Close this window without starting another operation.
cancelButton: Close this window without starting another operation.
saveButton: Save the settings edited in this window.
provider: Choose the provider; authentication fields and available models depend on this selection.
providerPicker: Choose the provider; authentication fields and available models depend on this selection.
modelPicker: Choose an available model for this conversation after the provider catalogue has loaded.
effortPicker: Choose the reasoning level supported by this model for the current conversation.
scopePicker: Select the project bound to this conversation and its VBE operations.
approvalPicker: Choose when VBA edits need confirmation; project identity, privacy and revision checks still apply.
modePicker: Choose the agent's work mode for the next request.
codexLogin: Start account authentication for the selected provider.
codexRefresh: Read the selected provider's account status again without starting login.
codexStatus: Connection status for the selected account-based provider.
openAiEndpoint: Set this provider's API address; an incorrect URL can prevent models or requests from loading.
ollamaEndpoint: Set this provider's API address; an incorrect URL can prevent models or requests from loading.
openAiKey: Enter a new key for this provider; leave it empty to keep the saved key.
clearKey: Remove the saved key when settings are saved; an environment fallback may remain active.
manualModels: Enter the model or deployment identifiers required by this provider, one per line.
customName: Name this custom provider so it can be recognized in the chat picker.
azureEntra: Use an Entra bearer token for Azure; renew the token after it expires.
ollamaTemperature: Set Ollama sampling temperature from 0 to 2; a lower value reduces variation.
ollamaTopP: Set Ollama nucleus sampling above 0 and at most 1.
githubAccount: Choose the GitHub account for repositories; this is separate from Copilot authentication.
githubLogin: Connect a GitHub account through Git Credential Manager.
githubRefresh: Reload the GitHub accounts available in Git Credential Manager.
githubStatus: Status of GitHub repository authentication, separate from the chat provider.
themePicker: Choose light, dark or Windows-following appearance for VBAi.
nativeVbeDark: Apply experimental dark styling to native VBE surfaces; original editor colors are retained for restoration.
newChat: Start a separate conversation for the selected project.
options: Open conversation settings and additional actions.
history: Show the conversations associated with the current document.
historySearch: Filter this document's conversation history by text.
sessionList: Select a stored or temporary conversation to reopen.
showArchived: Include archived conversations so they can be reopened or restored.
chatTitleEditor: Edit the selected conversation's title before renaming it.
rename: Rename the selected conversation using the title entered above.
archive: Archive the selected conversation, or restore it if already archived.
pin: Pin or unpin the selected conversation in the history list.
deleteSession: Permanently remove the selected conversation from VBAi local history.
export: Export the selected conversation as Markdown; review its contents before sharing.
memoryToggle: Show the local notes associated with this document.
memoryEditor: Edit local project notes; they are transmitted only when attached to outgoing context.
saveMemory: Save the edited notes locally for this document.
attachMemory: Include these notes in the next message sent to the selected provider.
selection: Attach the currently selected VBA code to the message being prepared.
compile: Compile the selected VBA project and read the compiler result.
verifyAfterEdit: Request compilation after agent code changes when supported by the current workflow.
modules: Choose a module reference to add to the outgoing message.
methods: Choose a procedure reference to add to the outgoing message.
send: Send the prepared message and its selected context to the provider.
contextToggle: Inspect and refresh the project data and attachments that will be sent.
jumpToLatest: Scroll back to the most recent message without changing the conversation.
changes: Inspect code changes and the available revision-checked undo actions.
ChatContextChipView.open: Open this referenced module or procedure if its target is still available.
remove: Remove this reference from the message being prepared.
ChatAttachmentView.open: Open the attached code's target in the VBE when available.
ChatLinkView.link: Open the displayed external link through the safe-link handler.
copy: Copy this message's content to the system clipboard.
fork: Start a separate conversation from this message.
fix: Prepare a correction request from the issue shown in this message.
undo: Undo this code change if the current revision still allows it.
undoTurn: Undo the code changes of this agent turn subject to revision checks.
blocks: Choose a changed code block to undo rather than the whole change.
ChatChangeCardView.module: Open the module affected by this code change.
toggle: Expand or collapse this section to read its details.
recover: Restore the cut form controls when the saved recovery state is still usable.
sendNow: Request sending this queued message according to the current turn state.
ChatQueuedMessageView.edit: Edit this queued message before it is sent.
delete: Remove this unsent message from the queue.
explain: Prepare a request to explain a VBA procedure.
improve: Prepare a request to improve the current VBA code.
ChatWelcomeView.fix: Prepare a request to diagnose and fix a VBA error.
targets: Choose one of the matching VBA targets for this reference.
previewEditor: Type a message; add module or procedure references before sending.
unified: Show deletions and additions together instead of side by side.
collapse: Fold unchanged lines to concentrate on the changed code.
previous: Move to the previous changed block in this comparison.
next: Move to the next changed block in this comparison.
CodeDiffView.search: Enter text to find within this code comparison.
find: Find the entered text in this comparison.
grid: Read the before and after source with highlighted additions and deletions.
projectList: Choose the projects included in this view's read or discovery scope.
sharedContext: Allow read access to shared debugger, native inventory and clipboard data; no additional project write permission is granted.
applyButton: Apply the selected project read scope to a new conversation.
approve: Allow the specific VBE action described in this dialog.
reject: Deny the specific VBE action described in this dialog.
VbeApprovalDialog.details: Review the proposed action and its project before allowing or denying it.
resolve: Apply the edited Monaco version after the conflict has been reviewed and the project revalidated.
ModernEditorWindow.compare: Compare the Monaco text with the current native VBA text.
reload: Reload the current VBA version instead of the conflicting local edit.
ModernEditorWindow.restore: Review and restore an available local editor draft.
ModernEditorWindow.edit: Return to the editable code surface from the comparison.
tabs: Choose the section to display; changing tabs alone does not submit an operation.
settingsTabs: Choose the section to display; changing tabs alone does not submit an operation.
pages: Choose the section to display; changing tabs alone does not submit an operation.
pullTabs: Choose the section to display; changing tabs alone does not submit an operation.
resultTabs: Choose the section to display; changing tabs alone does not submit an operation.
remote: Enter the GitHub repository to link to this VBA project.
branch: Enter the repository branch used for this VBA project.
connect: Link the selected repository and branch to the current VBA project.
GitWindow.compare: Compare current VBA sources with their repository baseline.
fetch: Fetch remote references without treating that alone as a VBA import.
push: Publish local commits to the selected remote branch.
pull: Pull sources and run the guarded VBA import; inspect the result and save the document.
GitWindow.restore: Restore VBA from the available backup and inspect the recovery result.
previewImport: Preview the source changes that an import would apply before changing VBA.
cancelOperation: Request cancellation of the current operation; a native mutation already in progress may still finish.
cancel: Request cancellation of the current operation; a native mutation already in progress may still finish.
commitMessage: Describe the selected source changes in the commit message.
commit: Create a local commit from the selected source changes; Push publishes it separately.
GitChangesView.changes: Select the VBA source changes to review and include in a commit.
openModule: Open the selected module in the VBE without restoring its source.
restoreModule: Replace the selected module using the available repository version; review before applying.
GitHistoryView.history: Select a commit to inspect its details or compare revisions.
historyCompare: Compare the chosen repository revisions without applying them to VBA.
branchList: Select a local or remote branch for the branch actions.
branchName: Enter the new local branch name.
branchRemote: Include remote branch references in the branch list.
branchTrack: Create local tracking for the selected remote branch.
branchSwitch: Switch to the selected branch subject to the current Git and VBA state checks.
mergeBegin: Merge the selected branch into the current branch; review the direction first.
checkpointList: Select a stored checkpoint to inspect or restore.
checkpointName: Name the checkpoint so its purpose is recognizable later.
checkpointCreate: Create a checkpoint of the current VBA source state.
checkpointRestore: Restore the selected checkpoint through the guarded recovery workflow.
conflictList: Choose the source file whose merge conflict you want to resolve.
resolutionText: Enter the complete resolved file content, not only the changed lines.
mergeOurs: Use the local side as the resolution for this selected file.
mergeTheirs: Use the incoming side as the resolution for this selected file.
mergeText: Use the complete text in the resolution editor for this selected file.
mergeComplete: Complete the prepared merge after all conflicts have been resolved.
mergeAbort: Abort the prepared merge through the repository recovery workflow.
baseContent: Read the common ancestor to understand how the conflicting edits diverged.
repositorySearch: Filter repositories available to the connected GitHub account.
repositoryList: Select a GitHub repository before choosing its branch or using it.
repositoryBranch: Choose the branch of the selected GitHub repository.
organization: Choose the account or organization that will own the new repository.
repositoryName: Enter the new GitHub repository name.
privateRepository: Choose private visibility for the new repository before creating it.
loadRepositories: Load repositories accessible to the connected GitHub account.
useRepository: Use the selected repository and branch for this VBA project's connection.
createRepository: Create a GitHub repository with the entered owner, name and visibility.
pulls: Choose a pull request to inspect its details, files, comments and checks.
loadPulls: Load pull requests from the selected repository.
openPull: Open the selected pull request on GitHub.
loadDraft: Load the prepared pull request draft and review it before publication.
targetBranch: Choose the destination branch for the new pull request.
pullTitle: Describe the proposed change in the pull request title.
pullBody: Explain the change, validation and remaining limits before creating the pull request.
draft: Create the pull request as a draft when it is not ready for final review.
createPull: Publish the prepared pull request using the selected source and target branches.
pullDetails: Read the selected pull request's title, state and description.
files: Inspect the files changed by the selected pull request.
comments: Read the comments of the selected pull request.
commentBody: Read the content of the selected review comment.
checks: Inspect the status checks reported by GitHub for this pull request.
TestExplorerWindow.search: Filter discovered VBA tests by name or category.
outcomeFilter: Filter tests by their last reported outcome.
grouping: Choose how discovered tests are grouped in the tree.
testTree: Select tests or check them to define the next execution scope.
TestExplorerWindow.details: Read the selected test's source identity, outcome and failure details.
humanReport: Read the human-readable report for the current VBA test run.
compactReport: Read the structured JSON report for the current VBA test run.
copyReport: Copy the current VBA test result report to the clipboard.
exportReport: Export the current VBA test result report to a chosen file.
refresh: Discover the tests currently present in the selected projects.
runSelected: Run the selected or checked VBA tests.
runScope: Run the tests in the current visible scope.
runSelectedCoverage: Run the selected tests with the supported VBA procedure coverage workflow.
runScopeCoverage: Run the visible scope with the supported VBA procedure coverage workflow.
rerunFailed: Run again the tests whose current recorded result is a failure.
stop: Request stopping between tests after the current VBA test finishes.
source: Open the selected test's source in the VBE.
installSupport: Review the test support module and its source backup before applying it.
TestSupportReviewDialog.apply: Apply the reviewed test support after project revalidation and backup.
titleInput: Give the issue a concise title that describes the observed symptom.
descriptionInput: Describe reproduction steps, expected behavior and observed behavior; remove sensitive details.
preview: Review the complete report that will be copied, saved or sent.
sendButton: Send the reviewed issue report through the GitHub-first reporting workflow.
emailButton: Prepare the reviewed issue report for the available email workflow.
copyButton: Copy the reviewed issue report to the clipboard.
saveButtonReport: Save the reviewed report to a chosen local file.
saveReport: Save the reviewed report to a chosen local file.
CrashReportWindow.saveButton: Save the reviewed report to a chosen local file.
issueLink: Open the created GitHub issue when its link is available.
projectLink: Open the VBAi source repository on GitHub.
documentationLink: Open the maintained VBAi documentation on GitHub.
issuesLink: Open the GitHub issue form to report a VBAi problem.
copyDetails: Copy version and environment metadata for support without project source or personal paths.
updates: Check the configured release feed and display the available version.
check: Check the configured release feed and display the available version.
automaticCheck: Allow the scheduled daily check for an eligible update.
automaticDownload: Download eligible updates automatically when their package is available.
automaticInstall: Schedule installation after VBA hosts close when package trust and installation policy allow it.
previews: Include prerelease versions when checking for updates.
download: Download the selected update package and verify its identity.
install: Install the verified update only when the host and publisher policy permit it.
UpdateWindow.save: Save the automatic-update and prerelease preferences.
cancelPending: Cancel the scheduled update before its installation starts.
notes: Read the notes of the proposed update before downloading or installing it.
helpButton: Open the local French user guide.
ChatContextPreviewView.content: Read the exact context prepared for the next message; refresh it after changing referenced code.
ChatTextContentView.content: Select response text to copy it; use the context menu to copy a complete code block.
modelSummary: Open the provider, model and reasoning choices for this conversation.
conflictDiff: Compare the current and incoming versions of the selected conflict before choosing a complete resolution.
historyDetails: Read the selected commit and its changed sources without importing that revision.
importSummary: Review the incoming VBA components and changes before importing them into the current project.

menu.refreshModels: Reload the model catalogue from the selected provider without sending a chat message.
menu.docking: Switch the chat between a VBE docked pane and a floating window.
menu.verifyChanges: Choose whether to compile the project automatically after agent code edits.
